instruction: A glazed ceramic vase with a hand-thrown look: a rounded bulbous body narrowing to a slender neck and a flared lip, subtle asymmetry in the profile, and a few small chips at the rim. Glossy glaze coloring.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a glazed ceramic vase. A glazed ceramic vase with a hand-thrown look: a rounded bulbous body narrowing to a slender neck and a flared lip, subtle asymmetry in the profile, and a few small chips at the rim. Glossy glaze coloring. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
